title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
author: J. K. Rowling
summary: In his second year at Hogwarts, Harry hears a voice in the walls as students are found frozen. Rumours spread of a hidden chamber and a monster, and he and his friends try to find who is behind it.
readIf: you like a school mystery with cosy humour, creepy set pieces and clues that pay off.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, since it leans on that setup.

pairings.reason: A younger, stranger story with the same mix of wonder and creepiness.
A richer and more serious fantasy with a young hero, a puzzle and a strong sense of place.
The classic magic-school story that shaped later wizard tales, more reflective and grave.
